[F5321A Code of practice for police interviews of witnesses notified by accused

(1) The Secretary of State shall prepare a code of practice which gives guidance to police
officers, and other persons charged with the duty of investigating offences, in relation
to the arranging and conducting of interviews of persons—
(a) particulars of whom are given in a defence statement in accordance with
section 6A(2), or
(b) who are included as proposed witnesses in a notice given under section 6C.
